Historical schema4 experiment. CGDataProvider construction triggered zero getBytePointer calls in DEBUG; materialization triggered exactly one getBytePointer/release pair. Despite excellent transient memory lifetime, Release W2 latency regressed materially. Rejected and removed.
Historical schema4 experiment. Single-pass table-to-range parser did not show a repeatable latency benefit and produced an unfavorable footprint sample. That parser rewrite was reverted.
Historical schema4 candidate. Provider lock protects only immutable chunk-cache reference publication/lookup/clear; decompression and copies are outside the source-wide lock.
Historical schema4 experiment. Restoring the original source-wide callback lock removed concurrent scaling and regressed the immediate W2 A/B. Rejected; short-lock provider restored.
Historical schema4 same-window directional PINRemoteImage reference used around the short-lock candidate.

providerReadShape.finding: CoreGraphics requested exactly one row per getBytesAtPosition callback. The 1MiB decoded-chunk memo limits decompression to one decode per touched chunk, so changing chunk size alone does not remove row-callback or row-copy overhead.

currentCandidate.aggregation: For each of the 9 W2 resources and each metric, take the median across repeated runs first, then average those 9 resource medians. This reduces the influence of host spikes without treating diagnostic data as release-quality evidence.
currentCandidate.notes: The schema5 LZFSE candidate preserved the independent random-access chunk provider and one-chunk memo. Replacing repeated Data indexing in the canonical LZFSE outer-frame parser with one raw-buffer view reduced the directional callback resource-median mean from 378838 ns to 350493 ns and the display-ready resource-median mean from 1491965 ns to 1454069 ns.

decisions: Keep schema5 independent LZFSE chunks, the random-access row provider, and the short-duration decoded-chunk cache lock.
Keep canonical LZFSE outer-frame validation; optimize its mechanics with one raw-buffer view rather than weakening the trusted-load validation boundary.
Keep 1MiB decoded chunks; 256KiB, 1MiB, and 4MiB LZ4 mechanism probes did not show a useful decode advantage for changing chunk size.
Do not expose getBytePointer for transient whole-surface reconstruction on the W2 path.
Do not retain Compression scratch pools; same-process decode and encode probes showed no repeatable benefit over nil scratch.
Treat every simulator number in this file as directional until the ComparativeLab quiescent-host gate passes.
